metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Glute and Hip Pain IN SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that can help instantly relieve glute and hip pain—even in as little as 30 seconds.

These exercises focus on the glutes, the primary muscle group associated with hip pain and discomfort.

When the glute muscles become strained or inflamed, they can cause pain across the lower back, buttocks, hips, and even down the thigh.

To address this, we’ll go over exercises that both stretch and strengthen the glutes for fast and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works in a different way and will be shown in various positions. For best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and quickly relieve glute and hip pain from the comfort of your home!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:45 Bed/Floor Exercise
2:52 Seated Exercise
4:49 Standing Exercise
